text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
Espoir City received an incoming call on her smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Mm. That item came in, huh?
Got it. I'll go pick it up.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I'm gonna take a little detour, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
It's a joint I hang out at.
Come along if you want, but...
don't blame me if you get cold feet along the way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following behind Espoir City, she turns
onto an increasingly dim and deserted path.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"This back alley, see. It's narrow and a bit thrilling,
but it's a shortcut. At least for my 'regulars.'"

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: OAAAAAAH~~! OAAAAAAH~~!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't chicken out over something like this.
C'mon, let's get a move on.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hardly anyone around here, right?
It's the perfect spot for taking a stroll.
choice_data_list: (It's so quiet, it's kind of unnerving...)

text_block_list.name: Large Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over, a large dog was barking fiercely from a house
with a "Beware of Dog" sticker. It looked ready to pounce at any second.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm not scared at all, okay...?
Look, see, it's chained up, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Like this... I'm all bark
and no bite."

text_block_list.name: Large Dog
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrr...!
choice_data_list: You're looking pretty reliable today, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph... I'm used to it.
This road is basically my backyard.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: W-Well... if you're scared, don't stray away from me, got it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, I followed behind Espoir City through the dim, narrow alleyway. The place we eventually arrived at was—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Right here, right here.
choice_data_list: Your regular hangout is... a penny candy store?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
What? Got a problem with that?

text_block_list.name: Candy Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Ah! There you are, Espo-chan. I made sure to keep your share. Here, an assorted pack of lollipops.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Just ran out, so that really helps.

text_block_list.name: Candy Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you for your patronage as always♪ ...Ah!
I left out the popping candy stuff from last time,
so you don't need to worry, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tch...
Stop blabbing useless crap...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Inside the candy shop, there was a calming, relaxing atmosphere. It made the tense air of that back alley feel like a total lie.

text_block_list.name: Candy Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, I also stocked up on those new snacks with lottery prizes.
You love this kind of thing, don't you, Espo-chan?
Wanna give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... I'll pass for now.
I just wanna head home already today.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"If we pass by while that noisy one's tied up,
this one won't get spooked either."

text_block_list.name: Candy Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you did another patrol for me?
Then you must have been quite scared too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those words bring back the memory of a large dog's
bark suddenly echoing through a quiet alley.
choice_data_list: Could it be that large dog?

text_block_list.name: Candy Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Right, right. That big, scary doggy. I got barked at by that doggy before too, and it surprised me so much that I fell over.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
There's really one of those things here?
What a pain in the ass.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "Tch. Should I go over there and bark at 'em to 'keep it down'? ...Sheesh."

text_block_list.name: Candy Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Since then, Espo-chan always checks to make sure I'm safely tied up before coming over. Even though it means going out of her way.

text_block_list.name: Candy Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, on the days Espo-chan comes by,
I can walk around without a worry.
Thank you so much, Espo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wha...!! I ain't doing that at all!
I just take that path 'cause I like it, that's all!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Unlike a certain Trainer over there,
I ain't gonna get freaked out by some dog!"
choice_data_list: Good on you for helping someone out, Espo!
Good on you for helping someone out, Espo!
In that case, let's head back via that road one more time.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Unlike a certain Trainer over there,
I ain't gonna get freaked out by some dog!"
choice_data_list: Good on you for helping someone out, Espo!
Good on you for helping someone out, Espo!
In that case, let's head back via that road one more time.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Liiike I said!
I told you it's not like that!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I-If you say any more weird crap,
I'm gonna punch your lights out, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. If you liked it that much,
I wouldn't mind coming back one more time, though?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I am kinda curious how it's doing.
Guess I'll go check up on it. That dog, I mean.
